text:
I booked in advance via Facebook message, choosing Option B: a 90-minute facial massage + Thai massage for 1350 baht.

I found it incredibly relaxing. After the massage, I chatted with the owner for a long time. She was super nice and my favorite person on this entire Chiang Mai trip! She said the facial massage technique was something she developed herself. She diligently researched various facial muscles and acupoints, and shared tips on which areas to massage for health benefits. She even created her own set of facial massage techniques – very impressive!

The environment was quite simple and small, like a private studio. I felt revitalized after the massage – highly recommended! However, I suggest that women who wear makeup come before bed, as they apply some products to the face during the massage, so they will essentially remove your makeup first. You might want to consider going makeup-free for the rest of your trip!

A minor drawback is that some movements during the massage involve lying face down, but their pillows are regular pillows, so you need to alternate between left and right sides. Lying face down for a while can cause neck pain.
